name: AGC 229053 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 229053, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc229053-hubble
story: AGC 229053 is one of the small, gas-rich dwarf galaxies of the SHIELD survey, picked out by the ALFALFA radio survey. Hubble resolved its stars to help pin down how far away it is.

claims.text: SHIELD (Survey of HI in Extremely Low-mass Dwarfs) is a sample of gas-rich dwarf galaxies selected from the ALFALFA survey
AGC 229053 is one of the SHIELD II galaxies newly observed with Hubble's ACS
Hubble data gave a tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distance for AGC 229053
The SHIELD II galaxies have irregular morphologies
